svg.text: ENTERPRISE PYTORCH/GPU TO TPU/JAX MIGRATION: 3-LANE TRIAGE & 14-DAY POC GATE
3-Lane Triage (65% Turnkey MaxText/vLLM-TPU + 20% TorchAX + 15% GPU) Hits 98.5% PoC Pass
40 Enterprise Workloads: Tier 1 Blind 1:1 PyTorch/XLA Port (32.5% Pass, 16.4% MFU, $3.15M/mo) vs. Tier 4 (1.2 Wks, $1.42M/mo)
⛔ Tier 1–3 Traps: Blind 1:1 Ports & `.item()` Stalls
1. Porting Standard Llama/DeepSeek Loops Line-by-Line (6.8–9.5 Wks):
• Rewriting Megatron/FSDP loops when turnkey `MaxText` or `vLLM-TPU`
already runs the exact checkpoint at 58% MFU in 3 days!
2. Top 5 Eager PyTorch Habits That Cripple XLA (16.4% MFU):
• `loss.item()` step syncs, boolean masking `x[x>0]`, unbucketed
lengths, imperative `dist.all_reduce`, and BF16 RoPE frequency drift
3. Forcing Custom C++/CUDA (`csrc/*.cu`) Models Onto TPU:
• Burns 10+ engineering weeks porting niche 3D/physics CUDA ops
Production Failure Impact (40 Enterprise AI Workloads):
• PoC Pass Rate (Tier 1): Only 32.5% | Sustained MFU: 16.4%
• Engineering Effort: 9.5 Weeks / Model (Tier 1) | 6.8 Wks (Tier 3)
• Monthly Fleet Compute & Engineering TCO: $3,150,000 / month
🏆 Tier 4: 3-Lane Triage + AST Linter + 14-Day PoC
1. 3-Lane Workload Triage (65% Turnkey / 20% TorchAX / 15% GPU):
• Maps standard LLMs to `MaxText / vLLM-TPU` via weight conversion
(3 days); custom clean PyTorch to `TorchAX / PyTorch-XLA SPMD`
2. Pre-PoC AST Static Linter & Numerics Parity Gate (<1e-3 KL):
• Automatically flags `.item()`, `nonzero()`, dynamic masks & forces
FP32 on RoPE/RMSNorm/Softmax (`98.5%` PoC pass rate)
3. Structured 14-Day PoC Acceptance Rubric (57.8% MFU):
• Day 1-2 Audit -> Day 5 Parity -> Day 9 XProf -> Day 14 Chaos/TCO
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• PoC Pass Rate: 98.5% | Post-Migration MFU: 57.8%
• Avg Migration Time: 1.2 Weeks / Model (-87.4% vs. Tier 1)
• Monthly Fleet TCO: $1,420,000 / mo (-54.9% savings vs. Tier 1)
